title: Early axes

infobox.Hitbox: 2.2 range, 90 angle, 0.6 height, no multitarget penalty

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Early axes is the first dual wielded axe.
Its primary attack is a 4-step combo: two single hits, one with each axe, followed by two double hits using both axes simultaneously, resulting in a total of 6 hits. The final double hit deals 2x damage with each individual hit.
Its secondary attack costs 16 stamina and is a leap forward, followed by a slash with both axes for a single hit, dealing 2x the damage.
The Early axes deal Chop damage, which allows them to cut down the same trees than the Bronze axe can.

sections.heading: Crafting
sections.text:
The Early axes require two rare components be crafted:
• Curious axe head is found inside chest in the version 6 of Abandoned House.
• Mysterious axe head is found inside chest in the version 2 of Abandoned House.
